interpretation.audience: Gen Z (roughly 18-27), students and young workers cooking for themselves

hypotheses.statement: Gen Z meal-preps mainly to save money, not for fitness.
Eating the same meal all week is the main reason they quit.
Short videos, not recipes sites, are where they learn meal prep.

research_questions.text: Why do young people start meal prepping?
Which words and slang do they use for it?
When in the week do they prep and eat?
Which brands, tools or creators do they mention?

starting_units.reason: Large community where people post their weekly prep and discuss what failed.

queries.query: meal prep on a budget student

starting_units.reason: Where Gen Z shares short prep videos; comments show reactions and objections.

queries.query: meal prep for the week cheap

starting_units.reason: Long-form prep videos whose comments reveal what viewers actually try and drop.
